about.title: Hi, I'm Ömer.
about.subtitle: Who I am and what I work on.
body: I'm a software engineer. Most of my work sits where architecture meets tooling: I build open-source developer infrastructure — AI-native, spec-driven golden paths and composable .NET libraries.

The idea behind all of it is simple: a precise specification should turn into a correct, testable system, and AI should work inside the guardrails rather than around them. I care about architecture, correctness, and tools that make the right thing the default.
This site is where I put what I build and what I learn along the way. I write in English and Turkish; each piece stays in the language it was written in.
